description:
GPU-Z is a lightweight system utility designed to provide vital information about your video card and graphics processor.

GPU-Z is a lightweight system utility designed to provide vital information about your video card and graphics processor.
Main Features
- Supports NVIDIA, AMD, ATI and Intel graphics devices
- Displays adapter, GPU and display information
- Displays overclock, default clocks and 3D/boost clocks (if available)
- Detailed reporting on memory subsystem: memory size, type, speed, bus width
- Includes a GPU load test to verify PCI-Express lane configuration
- Validation of results
- GPU-Z can create a backup of your graphics card BIOS
- No installation required, optional installer is available
- Support for Windows 11 / Windows 10 / Windows 8 / Windows 7 / Vista / Windows XP (both 32 and 64 bit versions are supported)
- .. and yes, the author of CPU-Z has granted us permission to use a name similar to his product. Thanks Franck.
- Added GeForce 50 Hot Spot thermal sensor and the hottest memory chip is also reported (tooltip shows all memory chip temperatures)
- Added an "overclocking" readout on the advanced tab for NVIDIA, reporting OC frequencies, including XBAR, SYS, video clock and boost lock status
- Added support for reading NVIDIA SYS, L2 and Video clocks. These can be enabled in sensor settings, they are disabled by default
- Added a sensor that reports PCI-Express bandwidth throughput numbers in GB/s for NVIDIA GPUs
- When a sensor is not logged to file, its dropdown arrow on the sensors tab will be grayed out
- Fixed NVIDIA GP102 transistor count
- Fixed LPDDR5X memory detection on Intel Meteor Lake and Arrow Lake
- Fixed LPDDR5 frequency on Intel Alder Lake
- Fixed memory bandwidth reporting on some DDR5 systems
- Fixed Qualcomm Adreno 726 unit counts
- Added support for NVIDA RTX 5060 (GB205), RTX 4070 10 GB, RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server, H100 PCIe variant, Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB variant, P102-101
- Added support for AMD Steam Machine GPU and Radeon PRO V710 (second variant)
- Added support for Intel Panther Lake, Lunar Lake, Arrow Lake H (285H, 265H, 255H, 235H, 225H), RPL-H Refresh (240H, 210H), Twin Lake (N355, N350, N250, N150)
- Added support for Qualcomm Snapdragon X2-90, X2-85, X2-45
